reason_for_source_choice.schema_result: README states chick counts are available for Cape Royds and Cape Crozier only, 1996-2009; Cape Bird is absent.
reason_for_source_choice.consequence: 600007 cannot supply a three-colony performance predictor for the frozen Royds-Bird-Crozier prospecting-choice analysis.
reason_for_source_choice.fallback_rule: Use the predeclared second-priority resight-derived banded-breeder performance index; do not substitute colony size or an environmental proxy as the performance variable.

analysis_years.reason: Published 2026 methods state Cape Bird resighting effort became intermittent after 2013; later years are excluded from the primary choice analysis before movement outcomes are opened.
analysis_years.performance_years_needed: 1996 through 2012 as one-season-prior predictors when available

raw_reproductive_codes.breeder_evidence: Any row in the individual-season with Eggs or Chicks code 1, 2, or 8, exactly matching the frozen state-reconstruction rule and published breeder definition.

individual_breeder_outcome.unit: banded individual breeder within colony and breeding season
eligibility: Individual is classified BR in that season under ROSS_ISLAND_STATE_RECONSTRUCTION_V1.
Breeding colony is unique in that season.
At least one resight row at the breeding colony has a known Chicks code in {0,1,2,8}.
individual_breeder_outcome.binary_chick_presence: 1 if any eligible row in that breeder-season has Chicks in {1,2,8}; 0 if all known Chicks observations are 0.
individual_breeder_outcome.unknown_handling: Chicks code 9 is ignored. A breeder-season with only unknown/missing Chicks values is not used in the performance denominator.
individual_breeder_outcome.repeated_checks: Collapse repeated nest checks to one binary breeder-season outcome. Do not weight breeders by number of resight records.
individual_breeder_outcome.mate_double_counting_boundary: The unit is explicitly banded breeder, not nest. If both mates are banded they may both enter the colony-year index; therefore the index must not be called nest success or whole-colony productivity.

colony_year_state.raw_index: Mean binary_chick_presence among eligible banded breeders in a colony-season.
colony_year_state.complete_year_rule: A performance year is usable only if Royds, Bird, and Crozier each have at least 20 eligible banded breeders.
colony_year_state.relative_state: Within each complete performance year, z-standardize the three colony raw indices; call this P_c,t.
colony_year_state.same_year_focal_exclusion: Not needed for the primary first-breeding analysis because P_c,t is always from t-1, before the focal individual first breeds. Focal pre-breeders therefore cannot contribute a breeder outcome to their predictor year.
colony_year_state.label: banded-breeder chick-presence index

primary_temporal_alignment.missing_previous_year: Exclude the first-breeding event; do not carry forward older performance values in the primary analysis.
primary_temporal_alignment.reason: Keep a common one-season information lag and avoid outcome-dependent choice of lookback.

allowed: Number of eligible banded breeders per colony-year
Between-colony range of the raw index

claim_boundaries: This is a banded-breeder chick-presence index, not whole-colony reproductive success.
A high index can reflect hatching/chick survival and observation processes; it is not a direct fledging-productivity measure.
Do not redefine performance using chick size, nest position, or notes after movement outcomes are opened.
Do not use USAP-DC 600007 as a two-colony rescue if the three-colony primary analysis fails.
A positive settlement association would show that pre-breeders settle preferentially among visited colonies with higher prior banded-breeder chick presence; it would not identify the cue used.
